title: himawari-ghi-forecast-indonesia: Hour-ahead GHI forecasting benchmark for six humid tropical Indonesian stations, with Himawari-8/9 cloud retrievals
description:
Scripts and aggregate per-site results supporting the manuscript Improved Hour-Ahead Solar Irradiance Forecasts in Indonesia Based on Himawari-8/9 Cloud Retrievals (manuscript version 6).

The package covers six BMKG climatological stations in Indonesia (Banten, Bengkulu, Jambi, Yogyakarta, West Kalimantan, Central Java), with harmonised 10-min data from 2022 to 2025 (train 2022-2023, validation 2024, test 2025). Version 0.1.0 contains the code that produced every number of manuscript version 6 from database version 6.10: the build and audit stages of the database (clear-sky irradiance averaged over each slot, Himawari-8/9 cloud product re-extracted in station-centred boxes with the box cloud fraction, AWS meteorology checked against SYNOP and rebuilt with a causal estimator, SYNOP reports kept for 50 min), training of eight machine-learning and deep-learning architectures with five seeds at all six sites under one protocol, a ridge-regression reference, the source ablation of satellite cloud, SYNOP cloud and surface meteorology with daily-block bootstrap confidence intervals, convergence diagnostics, a synthetic-signal control, a hyperparameter search, satellite-latency and box-statistics sensitivity analyses, a logger-only evaluation sample, the figure scripts, and a checker that recomputes every number quoted in the manuscript.

No observational data are included: station observations, the harmonised database and model frames, clear-sky caches, prediction archives and trained models are withheld because of size and data-sharing policy. The harmonised BMKG station data are available from the corresponding author on reasonable request; Himawari-8/9 cloud products are available through the JAXA P-Tree system.

Version 0.x notice. This record is a pre-submission release prepared ahead of journal submission. It supersedes the earlier repository ghi-forecast-benchmark-6sites (v3.0.0, concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22929571), which is retained unchanged for provenance but should not be cited for this manuscript. The archived version of record will be issued as v1.0.0 once the manuscript is accepted.
